name: modern skin: menus, controls, panels, presets and the switch to classic and back (DESIGN §8.4)
description: Runs muted, offline-safe (nothing plays). The genre button and the ⋯ button open their menus; the Equalizer and Stations panels open; a band and the volume move; Save .eqf…, reset, Load .eqf… go through the presets menu; View ▸ Visualizer picks Pixel DJ, the source colours and a 10 s rotation; the Skins menu switches to the classic windows and back.
